contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete and worn copper-alloy Roman nummus of the House of Theodosius, dating to the period c.AD 388-402 (Reece period 21). SALVS REI PVBLICAE reverse type depicting Victory advancing left holding trophy and dragging captive, barred Rho in field to left. Mint of Aquileia. cf. LRBC nos. 1102-1113. Obverse description: Illegible. Obverse inscription: Illegible. Reverse description: Victory advancing left holding trophy and dragging captive with a barred Rho to left. Reverse inscription: SALVS REI-[PVB](LICAE). Mintmark: -//AQP. Diameter: 13.22 mm; Thickness 1.37 mm; Weight: 1.11g
